facts.fact: Communications minister Bosun Tijani said at Build 2026 in Abuja that the government's AI strategy aims to place Nigeria among the top 25 percent of countries in AI readiness.
Minister Tijani, speaking through NCAIR's national director, said Nigeria proposes pooling GPU resources with Rwanda, Senegal and Kenya so researchers can build large language models.
Minister Tijani said Nigeria is exploring a proposed Nigeria-Togo data park in Egbe, with about 60 percent of power capacity unused, to support computing infrastructure for Nigeria and West Africa.
